item.description:
Groundvane 0.1.0

First public release. A native macOS ground station for ArduPilot aircraft, built in SwiftUI rather than wrapped around the existing desktop application.

Connecting

  • Serial and UDP links to a flight controller.
  • Serial devices are discovered and ranked, so a probable flight controller is distinguishable from a generic USB adapter.
  • A link that stops delivering telemetry is reported as stale rather than left looking connected.

Fly

  • Live telemetry: attitude, position, GPS, battery, and system status.
  • Map view with the aircraft's live position, heading, home marker, and recent trail.
  • Arm, disarm, and mode changes, each behind an explicit confirmation and an eligibility check.

Plan, Analyze, Tune, and Configure

  • Mission planning and map editing.
  • Telemetry log download over the link, and log analysis in the app.
  • Parameter viewing and editing, and calibration workflows.

Updates

  • Checks for updates daily and never installs one on its own — installing relaunches the application, which is not always safe to do.
  • Background update checks are suppressed while a vehicle is connected.
  • No system profiling is sent with an update check.

Signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
